headline_findings: Pilot incident 273920 at 2026-10-28 21:27:45.542 EDT is a frozen primary representative. Incident-profile strict advice is SWITCH from exact F to exact G; screened endpoint proxy saving is 1415 seconds.
The Grand Central report illustration at 2026-10-26 10:01:05.641 EDT is a nonprimary STAY decision. Its 439-second alternative proxy advantage must not be called an algorithm Switch success.

The first actual strict incident-profile SWITCH with that same 439-second 5-to-4 proxy saving is the later nonprimary checkpoint 2026-10-26 10:04:28.593 EDT. Its predicted gain is only 305.637831926 seconds, and route 4 has an 18.407000065-second proxy boarding margin.

All eight distinct required endpoints match original raw CSV journals, exact route/service date/raw train identity and exact station. Endpoint-to-last-observed gaps range from 21 to 65 seconds; endpoint-to-marked-past gaps range from 27 to 68 seconds. No hours-stale endpoint is present in these audited pairs.
A bounded search of the loaded exact-route endpoint-label pairs found no earlier-arriving catchable Stay train than each selected Stay train. This does not prove train or archive completeness.
interpretation_limits: Outcomes remain final MTA prediction proxies, not independent passenger arrival measurements. Near-event journal disappearance is corroboration of proxy timeliness, not physical ground truth.
Current provider/authored walking times remain fixed assumptions; the Grand Central Switch boarding margin is narrow and can be lost with a modest increase in access time.
The F-to-G primary recommendation also appears in unmodified MTA mode; the example does not establish added value from the historical incident adjustment.
Exact train selections and predictions match the pre-score prepared artifact. No hindsight best-known field was used to select or replace a train for these checks.
The 5-to-4 change uses the same station path on a different exact line, not a geographic detour or pooled 4/5 service.
These audited examples do not validate all endpoint records in the dataset, nor a general recommendation success rate.
